milestones.title: NEAR AI answers whether it hosts Nemotron 3, Command A+, gpt-oss and Western embedding and reranking models (N1, N2, N2a, N7)
Your organization's own attested hosting (org-tee) serves a Western model

remediation: Every chat, embedding, reranking and vision model in NEAR AI's private hardware comes from a developer in the People's Republic of China, so under your organization's rules agent work has no private model there. The owner has asked NEAR AI to host Nemotron 3, Command A+, gpt-oss and Western embedding and reranking models (N1, N2, N2a, N7). Until then use your organization's own attested hosting (Phase 74.2), a Cohere vault, or a model on this computer. Source: .planning/phases/74.1-model-passports-use-tiers-and-western-defaults/74.1-CONTEXT.md D-26.
title: No Western model runs in NEAR AI's private hardware
